# Introduction to Probability · MIT 6.041

> Bilingual (EN/中文) study pack for MIT 6.041 Probabilistic Systems Analysis: Bertsekas textbook chunks, lecture notes, recitation solutions, problem sets, exams and review material.

## Lectures & textbook
- [01-教材](01-教材): Bertsekas & Tsitsiklis Introduction to Probability, bilingual chunks covering p1-539
- [02-讲义](02-讲义): lecture notes Lec01-Lec25 as .bilingual.md

## Practice
- [03-习题课](03-习题课): recitation solutions rec01-rec22
- [04-习题集](04-习题集): problem sets
- [05-考试](05-考试): midterm and final exams with solutions
- [06-复习资料](06-复习资料): review material
- [07-Tutorials](07-Tutorials): tutorial handouts
